subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------RE.ST.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 444 (MP(I)-18). MTH (methodology) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; RE-ST (restructuralism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-DY (information dynamics), AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment). From INFO-DY: IF-SPT (infra-spirituality). From AF-DY: INFO-INTR (information interpretation). From IST-S-ALGN: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From IF-SPT: RT-DY (reality dynamics). From INT: MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
